recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: dense technical reports on new language models surfacing overnight
voxel worlds outgrowing their memory before the graphics engine shifts
wildfire smoke tracing coastlines on weather maps
mostly clear summer afternoon over the bay, wind at sixteen
late July sun setting after eight in San Francisco

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Slide a weather balloon through narrowing corridors of clear air as smoke bands drift across a live map — miss a gap and the run ends in haze.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: Each 30-second run redraws the coastline of breathable pockets; threading three gaps in a row feels like reading the wind.
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: Smoke lanes narrow, drift faster, and occasionally merge mid-run.
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: watercolor weather-map overlays with soft ink bleed

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Sort falling voxel blocks into RAM bins before the heap bar overflows — mismatched types fragment memory and trigger cascading deletes.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Clearing a full bin triggers a satisfying shader-flash cascade; one clean sort chain can save a doomed heap.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: New block archetypes appear, drop speed increases, and bins shrink.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: chunky pixel voxels with glassy Vulkan-style transition flashes

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Deploy parallel coding agents from a phone terminal — tap on the pulse to launch each one, chain launches before the heartbeat window closes.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: Three perfect agent launches in sync stack a flow-state multiplier that visibly speeds the build bar.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: Beat subdivides into faster pulses; agents demand tighter timing windows and occasional hold-release gestures.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: neon wireframe terminal on dark glass

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick paper boats across SF bay currents to collect golden-hour light before summer fog rolls in from the west.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Boats that skim the sunset line score combo chains; one good flick can carry you across half the bay.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Wind gusts redirect mid-flight, currents shift, and fog creeps inward shrinking the scoring zone.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: paper cutout bay at golden hour with layered fog silhouettes
